audience: payment sales teams that track leads, merchants and users in IRIS CRM

useCases.title: Find leads by owner, source or status
useCases.text: List leads with filters for group, campaign, source, status, owner user and date range. Open one lead to see its status, owner and field values.

useCases.title: Read the notes on a lead
useCases.text: List the notes on one lead, optionally from one note tab, before you contact the lead.

useCases.title: Look up merchants by processor or status
useCases.text: List merchants with filters for group, processor, name, status, active flag and date range.

useCases.title: Check which CRM users are active
useCases.text: List the CRM users with their class and active flag.

useCases.title: Map lead field ids before a lookup
useCases.text: List the lead field definitions and their ids. Then read a lead to see the value of each field.
